review_notes: Read the whole file. Most functions are already bundled (AddChar, →*, ≃*). Grepped Mathlib: rootsOfUnityAddChar, rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv and bijective_rootsOfUnityAddChar are used only in this file. The one gap is that the bijectivity of an AddChar is stated as a bare `Bijective` plus a composite-with-equiv surjectivity lemma, instead of an equivalence. I confirmed that AddChar.toAddMonoidHom and AddEquiv.ofBijective exist, but I did not compile the replacement, and the Additive/Multiplicative coercions might need adjusting.

findings.problem: The file builds the `AddChar` `ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddChar n` and then proves that it is bijective, with a helper that states surjectivity of the composite `rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv n ∘ ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddChar n`. The resulting isomorphism ZMod n ≅ rootsOfUnity n Circle is only a `Bijective` fact about a coerced function. It is not packaged as an `AddEquiv`/`MulEquiv`. The composite with `rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv` into `rootsOfUnity n ℂ` is also an unbundled function composition, even though it is again an additive character.
findings.proposed_change: Bundle the bijection as an equivalence. For example, apply `AddEquiv.ofBijective` to `(ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddChar n).toAddMonoidHom`, which has type `ZMod n →+ Additive (rootsOfUnity n Circle)`. Or use `MulEquiv.ofBijective` on `.toMonoidHom`. Name the result something like `ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddEquiv`. Keep `bijective_rootsOfUnityAddChar` as the proof of its bijectivity argument. Define the complex-valued version as `(rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv n).toMonoidHom.compAddChar (ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddChar n)`, if such a composition lemma is wanted, in place of the `∘` statement.
findings.benefit: Users get an `AddEquiv`/`MulEquiv` with `symm`, `trans` and `map_add` API, and no longer have to rebuild one from `Bijective` with `Equiv.ofBijective`. This is the natural form for identifying `ZMod n` with the n-th roots of unity, for example when transferring `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity` or counting characters. The composite surjectivity lemma becomes simple lemmas about `MulEquiv.comp`.

evidence.excerpt: def toAddMonoidHom (φ : AddChar A M) : A →+ Additive M where
noncomputable def ofBijective {M N F} [Mul M] [Mul N] [FunLike F M N] [MulHomClass F M N]
